feature_contract.goal: Restore R84 native binocular GOAL/time/result glyph submission when the current physical Draw is fixed-function, without borrowing stale world c64, while enforcing same-original-game shader/epoch ownership for shader GOAL across both eyes.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only GOAL result, time and progress physical GPU source capture in native R84 R30 fixed-function/XYZRHW and R33 shader HUD, not +TIME, rank, menu, lens, SkyGlow, input/FFB, R26_SAFE, DX11 or frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original 0x004973C0 GOAL progress, original 0x004974E0 glyphs and exact result B9200/GOAL source scopes select queued SpriteNode or synchronous D3DX direct glyph.
Native R84 R30 fixed-function or XYZRHW Draw and R33 shader HUD Draw capture physical source from original game shader and exact queue, pose and current top-level GPU submission serial.
GOAL physical source remains coherent after native LEFT and before RIGHT RT/depth/viewport/c64 submission while original GAME state restoration and conservative fallback remain unchanged.
subcomponents: Distinguish GOAL fixed-function from shader-backed R30/R33 physical admission; never import unrelated world game VS c64 for native FVF glyphs.
Require shader-backed R30 GOAL c64 writer shader and epoch equivalence before native LEFT, matching R33, and fence left-to-right against original raw upload generation changes.
Exercise all GOAL source producers with positive/negative fixed-function, shader owner, shader epoch, raw generation, queue/pose and +TIME/world fallback tests and exact SHA Windows integration.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Fixed-function direct/queued GOAL glyphs retain eligible left/right stereo source without depending on a preceding unrelated world's vertex shader game c64.
Shader-backed GOAL rejects foreign current-vs-written shader/epoch or changed upload generation; unavailable tracking and unclassified GOAL retain conservative native fallback.
Full required GitHub Actions passes on final validation-bearing exact SHA with no CI skip; real Quest3/VDXR remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Latest R84 R30CaptureGoalPhysicalSource unconditionally stamped the last original game c64 regardless of physical current shader, even though fixed-function GOAL uses no VS c64; R33 rejected foreign c64 but also queried it for shaderless sources.
diagnosis.root_cause: Native GOAL stage/result fixed-function draws can inherit a preceding world vertex shader's c64 generation, wrongly denying one or both eyes; shader-backed R30 did not check original game write shader identity unlike R33. Both paths need identical source admission policy.
source_trace: Original GOAL 0x004973C0/0x004974E0/result B9200 exact ScreenHud text/sprite producer establishes physical SpriteNode or direct D3DX source.
R30CaptureGoalPhysicalSource now rejects a known foreign original game shader and epoch only for shader-backed draws; fixed-function goes straight to exact queue/pose/draw source, never stale WVP.

R33 captureGoalSource applies same fixed-function vs shader source selection, then existing original LEFT, post-left, pre-right, HRESULT, RT/depth/viewport and c64 restoration fences preserve native fallback.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Static C++ source correction and smoke verify eligible physical eye ownership fences, not observed headset binocular position. Quest3/VDXR live image behavior and FPS are untested.
alternatives_rejected: No global ScreenHud tagging of world/fixed-function draws; no forced D3DX Flush, unsafe queue promotion or disabling original fallback.
Do not borrow last injected per-eye GPU c64 as original game source evidence or weaken R33 shader generation validation.

next_action: Run mandatory exact SHA GitHub Gates; separate Quest3/VDXR hardware verification from automated results.
